description: Stereo equalizer with a high shelf, a low shelf and two peak filters

params.text: Sets the corner frequency of the high shelf
Sets the gain or the attenuation of the high shelf, in decibels
Sets the corner frequency of the low shelf
Sets the gain or the attenuation of the low shelf, in decibels
Sets the centre frequency of that peak filter
Sets the gain or the attenuation of that peak filter, in decibels
Sets the width of the band that peak filter works on
Takes the whole equalizer out of the signal path, and the lamp is lit while it is active

inputs.text: The left channel of the audio input
The right channel of the audio input

outputs.text: The left channel of the equalized signal
The right channel of the equalized signal

notes: the frequencies in Hz and the gains in dB are shown in the knob tooltips
